cell_type.evidence: Analysis of two TMT-labeled yeast TKO standards (TKOpro10u, a 10-plex unit-resolved standard; and TKOpro12, a 12-plex isotopolog-inclusive standard) showed that μPAC1 and μPAC2 yielded comparable numbers of unique peptides and proteins, exhibited similar reproducibility, and delivered equivalent chromatographic and spectral quality.
